mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_MEGA_CRUST (71), drawn as MONSTER_MODEL_CRUST = 52 (_enum.h:4202), so Monster53.bmd. OpenMU Version095d Maps/Icarus.cs:193 names breed 71 'Mega Crust'. docs/icarus-port.md.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13588-13611, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_MEGA_CRUST: Scale = 1.1f; Weapon[0] = MODEL_THUNDER_BLADE at Level 5, Weapon[1] = MODEL_LEGENDARY_SHIELD at Level 0; BlendMesh = 1 at BlendMeshLight 1. Its effects, in game/play: RenderEye(o, 26, 27, 2.0f) on eye00 and eye01 (:11213-11215, fx/eyes); its blow's Inferno at the attack's fifth key, CreateInferno and MODEL_SKILL_INFERNO (:1696-1708, kInfernoBlows); the Thunder Blade's and the shield's held sparks (:10238-10256, :10277-10282, fx/held_lights). Left out: the CPhysicsCloth cape on bone 19 in iui02.tga (:8820-8838) -- this renderer has no cloth.
right_hand_from: MODEL_THUNDER_BLADE is Item/Sword19.bmd (built for it) at +5, and MODEL_LEGENDARY_SHIELD our Shield15 at +0. Their bones are CreateCharacter's weapon switch: `case MODEL_CRUST: c->Weapon[0].LinkBone = 36; c->Weapon[1].LinkBone = 45` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11962-11965) -- knife_gdf and hand_bofdgne01 in Monster53.
rig_from: Exported with --actions=all, 7 actions, 55 bones; keys 6, 6, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7. Its death plays at 0.22 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3738-3745), in actions.json's action_overrides.
sheet_from: Data/Monster's iui01.OZT (256 square, blue-grey riveted plate with a frosted rim, its alpha cutting the rim's feathers, 932 triangles) and iui02.OZJ (64 square, flames, 32 triangles: the stream mesh), under a crust_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: iui01 is painted plate, painted_steel; iui02 is drawn as a glow, so its material only names it.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V and striping plate; the armour sets' cast grain instead, as the Tarkan monsters.
soft_alpha_from: iui01.OZT is drawn by MU tested and blended (EnableAlphaTest): the plate's frosted rim feathers out.
glow_from: BlendMesh 1 at light 1: mesh 1, the flames (iui02), drawn added (ZzzBMD.cpp:1509-1516), and MoveCharacterVisual slides its U: `o->BlendMeshTexCoordU = -(float)((int)(WorldTime) % 10000) * 0.0004f` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:5819-5821), 0.4 of the sheet a second.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3738-3745: SetMonsterSound(..., 180, 180, 181, 181, 182): mMegaCrust1 to move, mMegaCrustAttack1 to attack, mMegaCrustDie to die. Wired as megacrust_* in sounds.json.
